items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I don't know how Kid Carter got them dates.

ctx.x: But you know, I studied history... Oh. In school, I was a good basketball player. So our coach... My coach was a history teacher, so I was crazy about history. I studied history. I kept up with them grades in history. And that meant... When I got out in North Dakota nad got in them Black Hills...that's in South Dakota... We traveled all around, in Bismarck... And we even traveled all the way out to Colorado. I don't know how Kid Carter got them dates. But when we got...
You were riding in a car, huh?
